deployments_detail.use: AIDA (Artificial Intelligence Dashboard Automation) decision-support system to optimize ore processing and mineral recovery (copper/gold)
deployments_detail.value: up to 2.5% improvement in mineral recovery

deployments_detail.use: AIDA (Artificial Intelligence Dashboard Automation) with an AI-driven Set Point Optimizer that recommends operating parameters (reagent dosage, water flow) in the mineral-processing plant. Built on 25+ years of operational data and millions of real-time data points; operations/metallurgy teams review AI recommendations every four hours before acting. Deployed at the Batu Hijau copper-gold operation. [none named]
deployments_detail.value: ~2.5% increase in mineral recovery at Batu Hijau

deployments_detail.use: 4D blasting modeling / Orica 4D Surface Bulk System for finely controlled detonations that fragment ore to optimal size for downstream processing, improving fragmentation, reducing powder factor and speeding bucket fill times. [Orica (4D Surface)]

3D Particle Size Measurement (3DPM) using real-time 3D laser scanning / laser triangulation on conveyors before the SAG Mill to measure shape, size and volume of material and detect oversized/foreign objects. Upgrade from prior 2D camera systems, improving processing decisions and reducing disruptions. [none named]
Laser scanners track material from shovel to stockpile, providing an accurate, real-time inventory of material volume and quality across the mining value chain. [none named]
UAV / drone survey and mapping program (topographic and LiDAR surveying of the mine site), with certified remote-pilot training conducted for AMMAN's surveyors. [Terra Drone Indonesia]

Full digitalization of procurement via SAP Business Network and SAP Ariba Supplier Lifecycle and Performance for supplier onboarding, PO exchange, compliance and license management. Won SAP 'Transformation Journey Award'. [SAP]
deployments_detail.value: 100% of goods procurement via SAP Business Network within 9 months of go-live; 1,500+ POs processed per week; 214,000 sheets of paper saved in 6 months

deployments_detail.use: Cloud-first ERP/HR transformation: SAP S/4HANA and SAP SuccessFactors deployed on Microsoft Azure, replacing a decade-old ERP, with data migrated to the cloud. Implemented with Accenture (myConcerto for mining). Went live Sept 2021. [SAP, Microsoft Azure, Accenture]

Enterprise analytics and planning stack built on SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC) and SAP Datasphere, alongside S/4HANA and Ariba (SAP BTP), used for reporting/planning. Evidenced by AMMAN's long-running SAP Portfolio Lead role (since Dec 2021) spanning S/4HANA, Ariba, SAC, and Datasphere. [SAP (Analytics Cloud, Datasphere, BTP)]
